purpose: Define the storage-neutral trusted-input resolution meaning that supplies authentication evidence and route authorization bindings to the admitted authorization-command boundary.

definitions.meaning: A server-owned logical repository that preserves every authentication-evidence record matching an opaque evidence reference without selecting persistence technology.

A server-owned logical repository that preserves every route-authorization binding matching a route identity and supplies its exact resource, action, scope, and scope-evidence reference without selecting persistence technology.

An authentication-evidence record whose trusted flag is true, revoked flag is false, non-empty evidence and session identities match the query, and injected decision time is strictly less than its expiry.
A route-authorization binding whose enabled and complete flags are true and whose route, permission, and scope-evidence values are non-empty.
The multiplicity-preserving authentication-evidence and route-binding sets returned from one exact query without collapsing missing or duplicate records.
A provider, conversion, clock, or query failure that yields no trusted authority and must become the existing public DENY result.

claim_limit: Candidate storage-neutral definitions with one separately bound SQLite realization; no authentication protocol, route administration, transport, publication, deployment, or production authority.
